pilot_policy: Engineering pilots used seeds >= 100 on the Darwin corpus only, to fix defects (step scaling, batching, split granularity). Final runs use the seeds below; no final result is re-run with a different seed or setting after it is seen.
hardware: 1x NVIDIA RTX 5080 16 GB, 32 GB RAM (measured); CPU smoke profile on the same host with CUDA hidden

gpt2.family: gpt2 (source only; not a supported base)

austen-pride.use: style for the planted source edit (evaluator only)

budgets.equal_across_methods: data, splits, steps, batch size, retain weight, prior weight and evaluation are identical; trainable parameter counts differ by method and are reported

methods.structured: Create Mode default: regions and subspaces from structural inference
methods.random-subspace: ablation: the same regions, random orthonormal initial subspaces
methods.random-regions: ablation without the structural stage: random regions and random subspaces, same count and rank
methods.lora: baseline: LoRA rank 8 on every q/k/v/o/gate/up/down map
methods.lora-matched: baseline: LoRA with the structured run's rank on the same number of random regions (matched trainable parameters)

E1_planted_same_architecture.source: base + a rank-4 edit confined to one secret linear map, trained by the evaluator on austen-pride windows (300 steps). The region is drawn by a per-seed secret RNG over all 210 maps; reconstruction never sees it.
E1_planted_same_architecture.evidence: 480 template prompts; one source continuation each (temperature 1.0, 128 new tokens), as passages with known context
E1_planted_same_architecture.isolation: source directory mode 000 during reconstruction; Python audit hook logs every opened path; the run fails if any source path is opened
evaluator_metrics: KL(source || model) per token on test contexts
rank of the planted region in the structural ranking
region-class test status and best region
relative error and cosine of Δ·X on held-out inputs of the planted region

E2_different_architecture.evidence: the E1 prompt set; one gpt2 continuation each (temperature 1.0, 128 new tokens)
evaluator_metrics: NLL of model generations under the source (source as judge)
E2_different_architecture.not_applicable: source parameter comparison: no shared parameter space

expand_and_cluster.teachers: tanh, d_in in {4, 8}, width in {2, 4}, 3 teachers each, uniform inputs on [-sqrt3, sqrt3], 3000 points
controls: output noise sd 0.05 of output sd

E4_underdetermined_and_misspecified.permuted_equivalent_source: E1 seed-0 source with the MLP neurons of the planted layer permuted: identical function, different coordinates
E4_underdetermined_and_misspecified.out_of_class_source: base + rank-4 edits in three regions of different layers (seed 0)
E4_underdetermined_and_misspecified.missing_context: E1 seed-0 evidence with every context dropped (output-only passages)

instructed.prompt: Preserve the formal voice and paragraph structure

metrics: style distance on held-out sections and new topics

E6_tools_and_visible_reasoning.source: scripted agent (different architecture: a program) with 5 tools, visible reasoning and final answers

acceptance.A1_selection_beats_random_regions: mean over seeds of test NLL(random-regions) − test NLL(structured) > 0.005 nats/token and structured better in every seed (E1, E2-smollm, E5-smollm)
acceptance.A3_trial_edit_prediction: Spearman(region score, measured validation gain) > 0.3 and top-vs-random permutation p < 0.05 in each structured run
acceptance.A4_planted_localization: planted region ranked within the top 12 of 210 in at least 2 of 3 seeds (chance 5.7% per seed)
acceptance.A5_no_false_recovery: out-of-class source never receives explained_by_single_region; no run reports partial recovery for the permuted source's coordinates without the conditional label
acceptance.A6_behavioral: structured test-NLL improvement interval above zero in every E1, E2, E5 and E6 run
acceptance.A7_retention: fact cloze accuracy drop <= 0.10 and held-out retain KL <= 0.05 nats/token for structured runs
acceptance.A8_export: every export passes schema, confinement and fresh-process reload checks
acceptance.A9_corpus_generalization: structured new-topic style distance below the base's, with mean 8-gram overlap < 0.05
acceptance.A10_tools: structured schema validity >= 0.9 and mock-task success above the base
acceptance.A11_declared_head: sampled condition recovered_in_class with relative canonical error < 0.2; greedy condition deterministic_outputs_not_identifiable; wrong-layer condition reported (rejection expected but not guaranteed)
acceptance.A12_expand_and_cluster: at expansion 4, at least half of the teachers recovered with the true width and max cosine distance < 0.01; the expansion-1 and ReLU controls do not exceed the main condition's success rate
acceptance.reporting: Every criterion is reported as passed or failed, including failures; no seed is dropped.
